description_zh: 调用QueryMetric查询相关监控指标
kebab_example: aliyun xtrace query-metric --start-time 1575561600000 --end-time 1575622455686 --metric appstat.incall --measures rt --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMetric

parameters.help_en:
The time interval at which you want to query metric data. Unit: milliseconds. Minimum value: 60000. 

If you set this parameter to 2147483647, all data in the specified time interval is returned
parameters.help_zh: 数据片的时间间隔，单位为毫秒，最小值为60000
parameters.name: interval_in_sec

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a timestamp that is accurate to milliseconds.

The value of this parameter is of the LONG type. Precision loss may occur during serialization or deserialization. The value must be less than or equal to 9007199254740991
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间，精确到毫秒（ms）。

<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a timestamp that is accurate to milliseconds.

The value of this parameter is of the LONG type. Precision loss may occur during serialization or deserialization. The value must be less than or equal to 9007199254740991
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间，精确到毫秒（ms）。

<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The field based on which you want to sort the returned entries
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，根据查询返回字段中的某个字段排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries that you want to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric. Valid values:

`appstat.incall`: trace statistics 
`appstat.sql`: SQL statistics
parameters.help_zh:
指标名称，取值：

`appstat.incall`：接口统计。

`appstat.sql`：SQL统计
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the returned entries. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order 
DESC: descending order
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxy user
parameters.name: proxy_user_id

fields.help_en: The key of the field that you want to use to filter the returned entries
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the field that you want to use to filter the returned entries
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The dimensions of the metric that you want to query
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en: The measures of the metric that you want to query
parameters.name: measures
